model.algorithm: Episodic REINFORCE with train-only exponential running baseline and Adam ascent
model.architecture: 14-feature linear softmax insertion policy; separate Save/Time weights
model.reward: negative canonical objective /100 Save or /60 Time; 100 penalty per unserved order or idle Time driver
limitations: Same fixed 20-node topology across splits; seed separation is not unseen geography.
Small synthetic training distribution, not a neural attention model or traffic predictor.
Deterministic order sequencing and hand-engineered features; only feasible insertion selection is learned.
No superiority or optimality guarantee; training time is separate from inference.
model.method_label: Locally trained linear RL insertion policy

metadata.protocol: Frozen trained checkpoint; 12 held-out instance seeds per mode; one-second native budgets; zero-policy ablation; 5 PyVRP seeds on instance3000 in each mode; no test-based retraining

limitations: Small synthetic 20-node topology; held-out instance seeds do not establish unseen-city or real-world generalization.
Objective averages mix different rates and workload sizes; use paired per-case gaps for method comparisons.
Feasible-only objective means report their denominators; failures never win.
Native solvers have one-second search budgets; learned policy and scratch may finish earlier; training cost is separate.
Five-seed variability experiment covers one instance per mode, not the whole distribution.
Time values are assumptions-based estimates with simultaneous starts, not live traffic ETA.
PyVRP Time is a named hybrid, not a native minimax algorithm.
